measurementContract.groundMethod: Fresh alpha>=64 boot-only sole segment ROIs, individually selected and measured in every final cell. measurementContract.capMethod: Fresh alpha>=64 minimum Y in visually selected cap-only regions in every final cell, excluding upright musket/bayonet, shoulders and roll. No cap/sole/root measurements are inherited from colored intermediates, guides or prior accepted sources.
measurementContract.referenceMethod: Median of four fresh final-native cap-top to individual leading/supporting-sole spans, rounded to nearest native pixel with half upward; one source-wide scale across all four phases, no per-cell or per-phase rescaling.

nativePixelEvidence.coloredRGBAssessment: Targeted red/yellow pixels are absent at alpha64; near-transparent residue remains untouched. This is not exhaustive alpha/fringe certification.

limits: Acceptance binds only to this exact final-native SHA and all four independently inspected cells for local Gettysburg v15 opt-in preview.
Four discrete contact/passing illustrations are not continuous skeletal animation, proof of physical gait, verified historical marching drill or zero foot sliding.
Concealed hips/pelvis, thigh overlap, toes/heel attachment, camera-space depth and the supporting versus swinging sole assignment remain 2D model-assisted interpretations.

SW opposite-passing lift is modest and both boots are close in screen Y; full chain and structural-reference comparison support limited role alternation while exact ground/airborne depth remains uncertain.

Final-native cap-to-selected-sole spans are [411, 392, 380, 364] pixels; reference height 386 retains 47-pixel variation (12.18%). Posture, camera/foot depth and source body/framing variation are not separated or normalized.

The built-in color-removal edit also changed some body/framing and untargeted kit details relative to the colored intermediary. Final source was re-inspected and freshly measured; exact geometry/pixel equivalence to intermediary or native 3D guide is not claimed.

Broad gray cap/jacket, tan trousers, dark boots, brown straps, black pouches and tan roll remain compatible with Confederate A; exact face, skeleton and manufactured kit continuity is not established.
Nearly transparent red/yellow RGB residue remains untouched below alpha64; targeted padding/color checks do not establish exhaustive fringe cleanup or perfect alpha.
Model-assisted independent inspection; human, physical anatomy, historical equipment/drill, default, production and complete-family certification remain false.
Renderer temporal behavior, turn/action continuity, pause/checkpoint geometry, decoded/GPU/process residency, device performance and human usability remain separate checks.
registrationAssessment: Four freshly measured final-native leading/supporting sole Ys and independently estimated pelvis X, one rounded median cap-to-sole source reference. Final native pixels/layout unchanged during review; no mouth anchor claimed for march.
